subject: Fix sentinel failover coordinated segfault when old leader's client is disconnected (#4068)
reason: The change is a NULL-check in sentinelKillClients in src/sentinel.c, code that executes only inside a Valkey Sentinel process during a coordinated failover (SENTINEL FAILOVER ... COORDINATED) when the Sentinel's command link to the old primary is disconnected. The fuzzer cannot reach this code: its only deployment modes are standalone and cluster, no installed experiment or component starts a Sentinel process (valkey-server --sentinel), valkey.action.commands' private servers are ordinary servers on which SENTINEL commands do not exist, valkey.action.tools runs only the four client tools, and
